meta.title: 7ayLabs · The Web3 laboratory for apps, software and intelligence
meta.description: 7ayLabs is a Web3 laboratory. We design, build and run our own apps, software, AI and on-chain products, starting with Vizzor: crypto intelligence graded in public.

footer.tagline: The Web3 laboratory. Software you can check.

hero.title: The Web3 laboratory.
hero.sub: 7ayLabs designs, builds and runs its own apps, software, intelligence and on-chain products. Each one starts as an experiment and leaves the lab only when it holds up in public. The first, Vizzor, is live.

board.title: In the lab right now
board.nextLine: Not announced yet. We show things when they work.

fields.title: Four disciplines. One bench.
fields.lede: Apps, software, intelligence and on-chain work are built side by side here, by the same people, so every product gets all four.

apps.title: Apps
apps.line: Products people open every day, on the web and on their phones, built to be understood without a manual.

software.title: Software
software.line: The engines, tools and infrastructure underneath: the parts nobody sees and everything depends on.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.line: Models and agents that read data, reason about it and answer in plain words, with their work shown.

onchain.title: On-chain
onchain.line: Wallets, payments and contracts that settle on public blockchains, where anyone can check what happened.

method.title: Rules of the lab.
method.lede: Four habits behind everything we ship. They are why Vizzor publishes its misses.

receipts.title: Receipts over promises
receipts.line: If we say something works, there is a public record that shows whether it did.

plain.title: Plain words
plain.line: People should not need a manual to ask a question or to understand the answer.

privacy.title: Collect less
privacy.line: We keep the data a feature needs and nothing else. This site sets no tracking cookies.

ship.title: Ship, then show the work
ship.line: Small releases, often, each one written up so you can see what changed.

updates.title: Lab notes.
updates.lede: Releases and news, written up as they happen.

faq.title: Straight answers.
faq.lede: The questions we hear most, without the pitch.

stack.title: Five layers, all ours.
stack.lede: From the screen down to the servers, every layer under our products is built and run in-house.

interface.name: Interface
interface.line: The apps people use, on the web and installed on a phone, in three languages.

engine.name: Engine
engine.line: Our own service. It gathers the data, runs the models and keeps the public record.

models.name: Intelligence
models.line: ChronoVisor, our model layer, built on Claude. It reasons over the data and explains its answer.

chains.name: Chains
chains.line: {count} blockchains read directly, and the wallets people already use.

ground.name: Ground
ground.line: Our own servers on a private network, with nightly backups and every release checked before it ships.

products.title: What has left the lab.
products.lede: A product ships when it works in public, not when it is announced. One has so far, and more are on the bench.

vizzor.line: Vizzor makes price calls with a target, a deadline and a confidence, then grades every one in public. It also traces wallets and follows large holders across {count} blockchains.

next.title: More is being built.
next.line: We do not announce products before they work. Subscribe below and you will hear about the next one the day it ships.

platforms.title: Where Vizzor runs
platforms.note: Live means open to everyone today. In testing means built and running on our test site, and released once it is proven.

what.a: A full Web3 laboratory. We design, build and run our own apps, software, intelligence and on-chain products. The first one is Vizzor.

vizzor.a: Crypto intelligence. You ask about a token, a wallet or a tokenized stock, and it answers with a price call, a trade plan and the on-chain evidence. Every call has a deadline and gets graded in public when it arrives.

relation.a: 7ayLabs is the company and the lab. Vizzor is the first product to come out of it. This site is about the lab; vizzor.ai is where that product lives.

free.q: Can I try Vizzor for free?
free.a: Yes. There is a free plan, and paid plans add deeper models and more daily answers. Current plans are on vizzor.ai.

work.q: How do I reach the team?
work.a: Use the contact page for partnerships, press and anything about the company. For help using Vizzor, start with its docs.

more.a: Yes. Others are in development. We announce a product when it works in public, not before.

demo.gradedWrong: The deadline hit. The call was wrong, and it stays on the record.

meta.title: Vizzor
meta.description: Vizzor is crypto intelligence from the 7ayLabs Web3 laboratory: price calls with a target, a deadline and a confidence, whale flow and on-chain forensics. Every call is graded in public.

vizzorPage.title: Crypto intelligence, graded in public.
vizzorPage.lede: Vizzor reads price, on-chain flow and the narrative behind any token, wallet or tokenized stock. Every call carries a target, a deadline and a confidence score, and gets graded when the deadline hits.

how.title: Ask. Get a call. See the grade.
how.lede: Three steps, and the third one is the part most tools skip.

ask.title: Ask in plain words
ask.line: Something like "ETH, 4 hours, $500 at 10x". No forms and no query language.

call.title: Get a call and a plan
call.line: A direction, a target, a deadline and a confidence, with an entry, two take-profit levels and a stop.

grade.title: See how it turned out
grade.line: When the deadline arrives the call is marked right or wrong and added to the public record.

desks.title: Four desks, one floor.
desks.lede: Each desk does one job well, and every one of them feeds the call.

predict.name: Predict
predict.line: A price call with a target, a deadline and a confidence, plus a trade plan built around it.

intel.name: Intel
intel.line: Whale flow, smart money, wallet tracing and hack watch.

markets.name: Markets
markets.line: Prices, a market heatmap and movers, with a call one tap away.

record.name: Track record
record.line: Every call Vizzor has made and how it turned out. Misses stay on the page.

editions.title: One model, three editions.
editions.lede: The model behind Vizzor is called ChronoVisor. It comes in three editions, one per plan.

items.zonda: The everyday edition. Enough to ask, get a call and follow the record.
items.kat: Deeper reads and many more answers a day, for people who trade actively.
items.zuor: The full model, with on-chain forensics and no daily cap.

editions.note: Prices and what each plan includes are kept up to date on Vizzor's own site.

whales.title: Whale terminal
whales.line: See large holders move as it happens, with a heatmap of where the money is going.

forensics.title: Forensics map
forensics.line: Follow funds from wallet to wallet and across blockchains after a hack or a suspicious move.

wallets.title: Wallets and portfolio
wallets.line: Link your own wallets and see your holdings, your changes and your graded calls in one view.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.line: Get a push notification when a price, a wallet or a call you follow does something.

news.title: News desk
news.line: The stories moving the market, read for you, with early signals before they are widely reported.

skills.title: Skills
skills.line: A directory of ready-made ways to analyse a market, and a lab to combine them into your own.

communities.title: Communities
communities.line: Rooms and channels for trading groups, where anyone can ask Vizzor right in the chat.

ranking.title: Leaderboard and seasons
ranking.line: A public ranking of traders by their own graded calls, with 30-day seasons and daily challenges.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.line: The whole product works in English, Spanish and French.

receipts.title: A record nobody can quietly edit.
receipts.lede: A track record only means something if the misses stay in it. Vizzor's does.

points.public: Every call is published before its outcome is known.
points.sealed: The record is sealed every day, so past calls cannot be changed afterwards.
points.misses: Wrong calls are shown next to right ones, with the same weight.

reach.title: {count} blockchains, read live.
reach.lede: Vizzor reads each network directly, so a wallet or a transfer is looked up where it actually happened.

meta.title: About
meta.description: About 7ayLabs, the Web3 laboratory behind Vizzor: why it exists, the rules it builds by, and how to reach the team.

aboutPage.title: A lab that shows its work.
aboutPage.lede: 7ayLabs is a full Web3 laboratory: apps, software, intelligence and on-chain. We design, build and run our own products, and we would rather show a result than describe one.

mission.title: Confident claims are cheap. Proof is not.
mission.p1: Markets are full of predictions that are never looked at again. The ones that land get repeated; the ones that miss disappear.
mission.p2: We think software can do better. A tool that gives advice should also keep score, in the open, where the people relying on it can see.
mission.p3: That idea became Vizzor, our first product. The same rule applies to everything else we are building.

meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: What 7aylabs.com collects, why, and how to have it removed.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: This page covers 7aylabs.com only. Vizzor has its own privacy policy on vizzor.ai, because it is a different service that handles different data.

scope.title: Who is responsible
scope.body: 7ayLabs operates this site and decides how the data described here is used.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: If you subscribe to updates: your email address and the language you were reading in. If you send a message: your name, email address, topic and the message itself, plus a scrambled fingerprint of your network address that we use to stop abuse and cannot turn back into the address. We do not use analytics, advertising trackers or tracking cookies. Your theme choice is stored in your own browser and never sent to us.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: To send the updates you asked for and to answer your message. Nothing else. We do not sell data and we do not build profiles.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: Your subscription stays until you unsubscribe or ask us to remove it. Messages are kept for as long as the conversation needs and then deleted.

share.title: Who else handles it
share.body: The site runs on a server we rent, behind a network provider that protects it from attacks, and email is delivered by an email provider. They process data on our behalf and only to provide those services.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of what we hold about you, have it corrected or have it deleted. Write to us and we will do it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this page changes, the date at the top changes with it.
